gates.name: Journey Entry
gates.description: The declared journey can be entered from its specified initiating condition and starting state.
gates.oracle_check: Actor successfully navigates to the journey entry point and initial state is established.

gates.name: Affordance Visibility
gates.description: The actor can discover the relevant affordance through discoverable UI controls without omniscient internal knowledge.
gates.oracle_check: Target control exists in accessibility tree and is visually rendered.

gates.name: Precondition Reachability
gates.description: Required preconditions are satisfied or an accurate blocker/unavailability explanation is exposed.
gates.oracle_check: Precondition verification passes or explicit fail-closed blocker panel is presented.

gates.name: Interface & Capability Binding
gates.description: The projected interface action reaches the declared capability/interface family rather than a mock, bypass, or unbound path.
gates.oracle_check: Dispatched request targets canonical SFWP method / CLI command / agent surface.

gates.name: Governed Authority Decision
gates.description: Required allow, deny, escalate, approval, or separation-of-duty behavior occurs strictly before side effects.
gates.oracle_check: Authority decision is committed to authority.json / ledger with policy hash before any command execution or file mutation.

gates.name: Governed Execution
gates.description: The intended action or state transition actually executes within declared sandbox, resource, and time bounds.
gates.oracle_check: Trace events record execution within granted boundary.

gates.name: Evidence Production & Integrity
gates.description: Required evidence is produced, attributable to actor, SHA-256 integrity-checked, and linked to execution.
gates.oracle_check: evidence.jsonl contains valid SHA-256 digests and semantic envelope references.

gates.name: Independent Settlement
gates.description: An independent oracle determines whether the canonical journey completion condition has actually been satisfied.
gates.oracle_check: settlement.json / authoritative records confirm completion condition is met.

gates.name: Resulting Affordance Continuity
gates.description: Settlement exposes the correct resulting decision or next affordance with carried context.
gates.oracle_check: Next lawful affordance is visible and reachable with correct state.

gates.name: Lawful Recovery / Terminal State
gates.description: Where the canonical journey involves error, interruption, or failure, a lawful recovery path or explicit terminal state is exposed and exercised.
gates.oracle_check: Failure state offers valid retry/repreflight/recover affordance without corrupting history.
